name: Auctions
description: Auction listings with starting price, minimum increment and end time; public bidding with validation, anti-snipe extension, live polling updates and winner reporting. WordPress parity: YITH Auctions / Ultimate Auction.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its admin page and its Verso block (in the editor and on public pages). Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
Read auctions, bids and the plugin's own settings table (currency symbol).
Create the auctions/bids tables, store bids from the public form and manage auctions from the admin.
Public endpoints for the auction grid, detail and bidding, plus admin CRUD/report endpoints.
Add the 'Subastas' entry to the admin sidebar.
Notify the previous top bidder when their bid is outbid (best-effort, bidding works without mail).
